scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs
scripts.console:build: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @basalt/eval-console
scripts.tasks:check: npm run build --silent && node dist/packages/cli/src/index.js task validate
scripts.test:node: npm run build --silent && node --test dist/test/*.test.js dist/test/e2e/*.test.js
scripts.test: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run docs:check && npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p apps/console/tsconfig.json && node dist/packages/cli/src/index.js task validate && node --test dist/test/*.test.js dist/test/e2e/*.test.js scripts/test-artifact-health.mjs scripts/test-discover-projects.mjs scripts/test-console-launcher.mjs && npm run plugin:test && npm run fixtures:test && npm run rojo:check
scripts.doctor: npm run build --silent && node dist/packages/cli/src/index.js doctor
